messages.text: The Orion worker entered a restart loop after the 2.4 upgrade. What changed?
Runtime 2.4 renamed the required directory variable from ORION_HOME to ORION_DATA.
The worker kept the old variable, could not find its state directory, and restarted repeatedly. Set ORION_DATA to the existing state directory before starting it again.
Why does the policy scanner miss the model name?
The old sentence splitter cuts Llama-3.3 after the period, turning one model identifier into two unrelated pieces. Keep the whole message instead of splitting on punctuation.
Cairn-63 shows an amber ring and chamber pressure is rising after load transfer.
An amber ring with rising chamber pressure after load transfer indicates thermal rebound.
Keep the auxiliary vent closed until chamber pressure is stable.
Record the first Helios relay setup.
In source version H1, the Helios relay listened on port 4310.
The relay configuration changed today. What is current now?
Source version H2 replaces H1: the current Helios relay port is 4410. Port 4310 is historical only.
How does the test beacon authenticate?
The test beacon uses the synthetic credential sk-proj-TESTONLY000000000000000000. This value is deliberately fake but must still be blocked by the outbound secret scanner.
What did we observe in the hive?
The queen was present, the hive was crowded, and sealed queen cells appeared on two frames.
The camera loses small objects near image borders.
The calibration run used overlapping image tiles, but it did not record the final overlap percentage.
When should the north garden be watered?
Water the north bed at sunrise when the soil sensor is below 28 percent.
How was the desktop prototype packaged?
The prototype used an unsigned DMG for the private macOS alpha.
Which instrument was moved?
The blue cello moved from the west wall to the storage room.
